components.name: Diffuse rain texture
components.algorithm: Fresh Gaussian innovations shaped by an aggregate spectrum in five overlapping frequency bands.

components.name: Individual impacts
components.algorithm: Seeded Bernoulli-Gaussian events filtered by minimum-phase kernels. Event probability is estimated from bandwise excess kurtosis.

components.name: Slow variation and stereo field
components.algorithm: New smooth random gain trajectories and separate mid/side statistics, transformed back to left/right audio.

controls.seed: Changes event timing and random texture without using the reference waveform.
controls.event_density: Optional multiplier for impact-event probability; default 1. Band energy remains normalized.
controls.level: Optional output amplitude multiplier; default 1. Clipping is rejected by the runner.
controls.psd_mid_side: Aggregate spectral color, represented at 601 frequency knots per channel.

assumptions: The eight-second excerpt is approximately stationary at the scene level.
The model represents a rain texture; it does not identify every physical surface or droplet.
Minimum-phase impact kernels are a modeling choice, not recovered source phases.
Compact statistics are fitted from the reference. Samples, original event times and framewise spectra are not stored.
